name: editor-adr0022-scales
description: ADR-0022 验收基线：1x/2x/3x 三档缩放下逻辑坐标均为 320x240，控件不越界、文案不超出控件、同级按钮不重叠。

check.name: 1x 缩放下控件文案不溢出
1x 缩放下同级按钮不重叠
check.expr: (function(){var bad=0;function walk(list){for(var i=0;i<list.length;i++){var kids=list[i].children;for(var m=0;m<kids.length;m++){for(var n=m+1;n<kids.length;n++){var c=kids[m],d=kids[n];if(c.kind!=='CONTROL'||d.kind!=='CONTROL')continue;if(c.x<d.x+d.width&&d.x<c.x+c.width&&c.y<d.y+d.height&&d.y<c.y+c.height)bad++;}}walk(kids);}}walk(__gp.layout());return bad;})()
